title_o: Self-handicapping, excuse making, and counterfactual thinking: Consequences for self-esteem and future motivation.
verdict_reason: McCrea.csv (OSF dy3zn) has 61 rows with Cond, Attempted, Correct; a one-tailed equal-variance t-test on Correct/Attempted, Control (Cond 2) > Handicap (Cond 1), reproduces t(59)=2.325, p=.01175. The table's d=.197 matches neither the script's d (0.30) nor the usual two-group d (~0.60).
